procedure: Bind draft, originals, current model and requested review scope.
Establish actual reviewer/channel independence or record unavailability.
Check numerical binding, original meaning, qualifications and substantive support.
Return issue-level findings, inspected coverage and actual review outcome.

acceptance.expectation: Coverage records inspected original/draft/model versions and measured hashes or access limits; citations and numeric displays are actually checked against those artifacts.
Independent review has a real channel identity and observed outcome; unavailable review, self-check and unperformed coverage cannot be recorded as an independent pass.
Meaning, calculation basis, qualifications, alternatives and decision consequence are supported by originals and current analysis, with factual/fictional modes preserved.
Source, numerical, substantive and editorial outcomes stay distinct; unresolved material findings restrict acceptance and route to their responsible owner.

conditions: Required source or execution tool unavailable
Acceptance test fails or remains unperformed
failure.record: failure_records; identify affected record, evidence/test, consequence, next action and conclusion restriction
